# Timber Unlimited

> A New Zealand industry resource for timber construction education, design standards, and community engagement promoting sustainable timber building practices.

Timber Unlimited is an industry-neutral non-profit organization dedicated to advancing timber construction across New Zealand. The site provides comprehensive educational resources, design guides, case studies, and industry standards while showcasing award-winning timber projects and fostering community engagement through events and competitions.

## Key Topics

- Timber construction
- Sustainable building
- Mass timber
- Fire safety
- Timber durability
- Design guides
- New Zealand architecture
- Building materials
- Environmental impact
- Construction costs
- Timber benefits
- Residential design
- Case studies
- Timber Design Awards
- Building standards

## Core Resources

- [Homepage](https://timberunlimited.co.nz): Homepage showcasing timber construction possibilities, design guides, and community resources
- [About Timber Unlimited](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/about): Organization background: industry-neutral non-profit promoting timber construction
- [Resources](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/resources): Comprehensive library of design guides, standards, and timber construction resources

## Education & Learning

- [Get Informed](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-informed): Educational hub exploring timber benefits, sustainability, and construction across NZ
- [Benefits of Timber](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-informed/benefits-of-timber): Guide to timber construction benefits including durability, sustainability, and thermal comfort
- [Decoding Timber](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-informed/decoding-timber): Educational material on timber material properties, costs, and environmental impact
- [Fire Safety in Timber Buildings](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-informed/decoding-timber/fire-safety): Comprehensive guide to fire safety design in mass timber and light timber buildings
- [Timber Durability](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-informed/decoding-timber/timber-durability): Technical guide on timber durability, decay prevention, and species selection
- [Timber Cost Analysis](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-informed/decoding-timber/cost-benefits): Analysis of timber construction costing versus alternatives like structural steel
- [Carbon Offset & Economic Benefits](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-informed/decoding-timber/carbon-offset-the-economic-benefits): Guide to carbon sequestration benefits and economic value of timber construction
- [Acoustic Timber Panels](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-informed/decoding-timber/acoustics): Design guide for acoustic timber panels and sound absorption properties

## Projects & Inspiration

- [Get Inspired](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-inspired): Showcase of award-winning timber projects and architectural inspiration gallery
- [Case Studies](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/case-studies): Real-world timber construction case studies from Christchurch and across NZ
- [2023 Timber Design Awards Winners](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/about/tda-winners): Showcase of 2023 Timber Design Awards winners and award-winning projects

## Community & Events

- [Get Involved](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-involved): Community engagement page for design standards feedback and industry consultation
- [Timber Design Awards](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-involved/timber-design-awards): Information and entry process for New Zealand Timber Design Awards competition
- [Timber Design Awards Categories & Criteria](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-involved/timber-design-awards/categories-judging-criteria): Timber Design Awards categories, judging criteria, and entry requirements
- [2026 Timber Design Awards Judges](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-involved/timber-design-awards/2026-judges): Meet the 2026 Timber Design Awards judges panel including Tom Webster
- [Timber Delivered Seminar](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-involved/seminar-timber-delivered): Event registration for Timber Delivered seminar in Auckland at Cordis Hotel

## Market Research

- [Asset Owner Research](https://timberunlimited.co.nz/get-informed/asset-owner-research): Market research on timber construction adoption by commercial asset owners
